'''Kupa''' is spoken in villages in Kupaland which are Abugi, Ikin-Sami circus of villages (Kapu, Agini, Buzhi, etc), Ikin-makun circles, Kuchalu, Sampi and Eggan ( all located on the southern part of the [[Niger River]]).

Kupa is under [[Lokoja]] L.G.A. It is most closely related to the [[Kakanda language]]. Koelle (1854) is a source. Egã (Eggan) village has very few Kupa speakers.<ref name="Blench2013">Blench, Roger. 2013. ''[http://www.rogerblench.info/Language/Niger-Congo/VN/Nupoid/Nupoid%20Overview%202013.pdf The Nupoid languages of west-central Nigeria: overview and comparative word list]''.</ref>

Kupa, also as a Tribe and district as its district head called the 'Maiyaki of Kupa' residing at Abugi. It has roughly 70 villages under it.<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=|first=|date=|title=Kupa-Nupe, Nigeria|url=https://www.facebook.com/KupaNigeria/|archive-url=|archive-date=|access-date=2021-01-14|website=www.facebook.com/KupaNigeria/|publisher=MA Zakari Brainbox|language=en}}</ref>
